mapper.select: SELECT warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", warehouse_name AS "warehouseName" FROM warehouse WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY warehouse_name, warehouse_id
SELECT product_id AS "productId", product_name AS "productName", lot_managed_yn AS "lotManagedYn" FROM product WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY product_name, product_id

SELECT l.lot_id AS "lotId", l.lot_no AS "lotNo", ls.quantity AS "quantity" FROM lot_stock ls JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ls.lot_id WHERE ls.company_id = #{companyId} AND ls.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY l.lot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stocktake ( company_id, stocktake_no, warehouse_id, status, memo, created_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{stocktakeNo}, #{warehouseId}, 'DRAFT', #{memo}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO stocktake_item ( stocktake_id, line_no, product_id, lot_id, system_qty, actual_qty, difference_qty, reason, created_by ) VALUES ( #{stocktakeId}, #{lineNo}, #{item.productId}, #{item.lotId}, #{item.systemQty}, #{item.actualQty}, #{item.differenceQty}, #{item.reason}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT st.stocktake_id AS "stocktakeId", st.stocktake_no AS "stocktakeNo", w.warehouse_name AS "warehouseName", st.stocktake_date AS "stocktakeDate", st.status AS "status" FROM stocktake st JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id WHERE st.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY st.stocktake_id DESC

SELECT st.stocktake_id AS "stocktakeId", st.stocktake_no AS "stocktakeNo", st.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.warehouse_name AS "warehouseName", st.stocktake_date AS "stocktakeDate", st.status AS "status", st.memo AS "memo" FROM stocktake st JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id AND w.company_id = st.company_id WHERE st.company_id = #{companyId} AND st.stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId}

SELECT sti.stocktake_item_id AS "stocktakeItemId", sti.line_no AS "lineNo", sti.product_id AS "productId", p.product_name AS "productName", sti.lot_id AS "lotId", l.lot_no AS "lotNo", sti.system_qty AS "systemQty", sti.actual_qty AS "actualQty", sti.difference_qty AS "differenceQty", sti.reason AS "reason" FROM stocktake_item sti JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sti.product_id LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = sti.lot_id WHERE sti.stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} ORDER BY sti.line_no
SELECT product_id AS "productId", lot_id AS "lotId", difference_qty AS "differenceQty" FROM stocktake_item WHERE stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} ORDER BY line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE stocktake SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{confirmedBy} WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_history ( company_id, warehouse_id, product_id, lot_id, movement_type, change_qty, source_type, source_id, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{lotId}, 'ADJUSTMENT', #{differenceQty}, 'STOCKTAKE', #{stocktakeId}, #{createdBy}, CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ) )
